description: This Python source file implements the NVIDIA Riva Text-to-Speech (TTS) service integration. It defines the `NvidiaTTSService` class, which provides methods to initialize the service with configurations, run TTS synthesis asynchronously, and manage related parameters. It uses gRPC for communication with NVIDIA Riva's cloud-based TTS models, supporting high-quality speech synthesis with various options for language and voice configuration.
